trigger: a reader of the README, privilege model, descriptors or capability matrix, which state the Windows least-privilege position as settled while cancel was measured only under Administrators and SYSTEM
summary: Unqualified Windows least-privilege claims qualified everywhere (README, agent-privilege-model.md, both kActionDescriptors tables, os-capability-matrix.md row and curated line, plugin-docs json): cancel measured only as Administrators/SYSTEM, a least-privileged identity cancelling any job is unmeasured. Descriptor stays SUPPORTED with a notes string. Also raised by plugin-developer (PD-1, PD-4) and docs-writer (F1). Fixed in 01adcc997, widened in b8f80a34d.

trigger: Windows job_not_found raised PARTIAL to FULL on GetJobW error 87, measured only as an elevated identity; if the spooler returns 87 for an existing job the caller cannot read, FULL would hide a denial
summary: Resolved by reverting the one label to PARTIAL rather than measuring with a standard user (01adcc997); SetJobW 87 (job finished between the two calls) also reports job_not_found/PARTIAL. plugin-developer PD-2 raised the same defect (derived HIGH, flagged for adjudication).

trigger: a future edit swaps a refused/not_found arm, token, status or completeness label in the Windows open-failure arms, the POSIX ladder or the no_identity guard
summary: The class-to-outcome wiring had no test on any host. The POSIX ladder was later moved into a pure run_clear_queue() over an injected transport and asserted whole (16e8ff780, 22a3d16e2); the Windows open-failure arms, the SetJobW arms and the status ternary still compile and run only on Windows, so #4680 stays open, narrowed to those.

trigger: printer=\\host\queue (or //host/queue) on Windows: OpenPrinterW returns 1801 for an unreachable server exactly as for a missing local printer (real-Windows log), so a FULL not_found asserts a fact nobody checked
summary: UNC-shaped names report printer_not_found as PARTIAL (01adcc997); generalised to an allowlist, printer_name_is_plain_local(), so only a name with none of backslash, slash or colon reports FULL (b8f80a34d). Native label SHOULD/MEDIUM disagreed with the derived HIGH; the derived band governed.

trigger: Windows OpenPrinterW/SetJobW failing with 1314, 1326, 1385 or 1244 (denial-like) reports error/PARTIAL
summary: Not changed by decision: the Win32 code is in the status detail and no information is disclosed; mapping unmeasured codes to refused would assert a denial nobody observed.

trigger: getpwuid(geteuid()) returning no name (transient NSS failure) on macOS/Linux
summary: no_identity first kept refused/PERMISSION_DENIED/FULL to match socket_unavailable; changed to error, UNAVAILABLE/PARTIAL in b8f80a34d because cupsd is never asked and a transient failure must not read as a final denial. Also plugin-developer PD-3.

trigger: Windows printer parameter accepts UNC names: the agent (LocalSystem) opens an outbound RPC/SMB connection; the new Win32 codes are a reachability oracle; README states no network use beyond loopback
summary: Independent surface outside this remediation; tracked as a hardening follow-up (the README sentence, the UNC handling and the jobs/printers rows rendering a backslash as a slash).

trigger: current_username() calls the raw, non-reentrant, possibly blocking getpwuid, and this range makes its result load-bearing for the no_identity refusal; other plugins call it in the same agent process
summary: Deferred: the bounded passwd_lookup.hpp / getpwuid_r seam belongs in its own change. cpp-safety independently confirmed the raw call and that it is not proven concurrent.

trigger: POSIX printers/jobs never read the HTTP status (401/403 reports decode_failed); Windows jobs does not capture last_error on an open failure
summary: Both report CONSTRAINED, never an empty success; parity with clear_queue's classification deferred.

trigger: cancelling a job that is printing, on an offline printer, or already deleting: canceled/OK/FULL was read as 'the queue is unblocked'
summary: Made true rather than wired to a readback: the YAML outcome text and README now say canceled means the spooler or cupsd ACCEPTED the cancel request, not that the job has left the queue (b8f80a34d). Windows readback stays informational.

trigger: macOS/Linux: cupsd's Cancel-Job looks a job up by id alone, so the printer named in the request was decorative and the approver's (printer, job) pair unenforced
summary: Reproduced on a real cupsd (a NONEXISTENT printer plus a valid job id cancelled the job and echoed the bogus name); Windows not affected (measured). Fixed by a Get-Jobs check that the id is listed on the named printer before Cancel-Job (3ab03ebec); filed as #4677.

trigger: cupsd stopped, or a transient NSS failure: refused/PERMISSION_DENIED/FULL read by an automated worker as a final denial
summary: no_identity is now error, UNAVAILABLE/PARTIAL (b8f80a34d). socket_unavailable stays refused by a documented decision and was re-graded LOW by three later reviewers (see sre-SRE4).

trigger: retrying a cancel whose reply was lost, or a job already terminal: cupsd answers 0x0404 forever
summary: A retry of an already-cancelled or completed job now reports not_found (the id is no longer on the not-completed list), 3ab03ebec.

trigger: OpenPrinterW name shapes other than UNC (mixed separators, extended-length \\?\UNC\, http:// URLs) also reach the network and return 1801
summary: Resolved by inverting the check into the printer_name_is_plain_local() allowlist (b8f80a34d); all four remote forms measured as 1801 on real Windows. quality-engineer N1 raised the incomplete boundary set independently.

trigger: printer=%00<name> (cupsd percent-decodes the resource, so the NUL truncates it to the all-printers collection) or a 65,536-byte name (the uint16 IPP length wraps and the tail parses as attributes) with any active job id
summary: The Get-Jobs pre-check then listed every queue's jobs and Cancel-Job (id-only) cancelled a job on another queue; reproduced end to end on a real cupsd. Fixed in 16e8ff780: the name is percent-encoded in every request, a name over 127 bytes or with a control byte is refused as invalid_printer before any request, ipp::encode_request returns an empty request instead of a truncated length, and the listed job's own job-printer-uri must name the requested printer. Raised independently by security-guardian, unhappy-path (R1) and cross-platform (F1); native MEDIUM disagreed with the derived HIGH.

trigger: a future edit removes or reorders the Get-Jobs guard: nothing pinned 'no Cancel-Job unless the id is listed on that printer'
summary: The whole POSIX ladder is a pure run_clear_queue() over an injected transport and a recording fake asserts exactly which operations were sent, driven by real captures (16e8ff780); plugin-developer F3 raised the same gap.

trigger: an operator pastes the jobs action's printer column (ipp://localhost:631/printers/NAME) into clear_queue.printer on macOS/Linux; before the binding cupsd ignored it, after it the row is not_found
summary: printer_name_from_operand() accepts the ipp[s]://host/printers|classes/NAME form so the documented list-then-cancel flow works, and README/YAML say so (16e8ff780). Also sre SRE-2 and consistency-auditor F1.

trigger: an operator or automated consumer reading a failed clear_queue: only the four-value status is on the wire
summary: README and YAML now say where the failure detail and FULL/PARTIAL are recorded (the agent log, not the response).

trigger: no cupsd socket reports refused/PERMISSION_DENIED/FULL while no_identity reports error/UNAVAILABLE/PARTIAL, though both mean cupsd was never asked
summary: Kept by decision: socket_unavailable is a deliberate policy refusal, commented as such (16e8ff780). Also enterprise-readiness EF-2 and consistency-auditor F3; graded LOW by all three.

trigger: git diff --name-only origin/dev...HEAD lists no governance.d fragment for this PR
summary: This fragment. Scope: it itemises every finding at derived MEDIUM or above, every mandatory investigation, and every deferral or rejection raised across six rounds; roughly forty NICE/INFO wording, comment and citation items were fixed in the same commits and are not itemised individually (see the commit messages 01adcc997..079d15121); a handful of final-round NICE items were left as they are (a provenance sentence, a ragged YAML fold, two small duplicated helpers, single-line if style). Native MEDIUM disagreed with derived INFO; the derived band governs.

trigger: printer=YUZU4616A for a queue cupsd resolves case-insensitively as yuzu4616a: the second guard compared names exactly
summary: A live job was reported not_found/FULL, a false definitive answer. classify_job_listing() compares ASCII case-insensitively and separates absent, elsewhere, unconfirmed and on_printer; only on_printer proceeds (22a3d16e2). Raised independently by plugin-developer, quality-engineer (R4-QE-1) and the adversarial unhappy-path pass; verified on a real cupsd.

trigger: a regression that changes a ladder branch's rc, status or completeness while its row text stays the same
summary: Every ladder branch now asserts rc, status, completeness and row (check_disposition), 22a3d16e2.

trigger: a regression in the destructive Cancel-Job request itself (attribute tags or values)
summary: The recording fake now asserts the tags and values of the Cancel-Job attributes and the second request of the URI-operand case (22a3d16e2).

trigger: the shell around run_clear_queue (socket, identity, per-OS tokens, the Windows arms) has no test on any host
summary: Tracked by #4680, narrowed by the ladder tests to the Windows arms and the status ternary.

trigger: Windows printer name containing a comma: OpenPrinterW gives it special-handle syntaxes (,XcvPort ..., Printer, Job N, ,LocalPrintServer)
summary: Measured on real Windows with PRINTER_ACCESS_USE: only ,XcvMonitor ... was recognised (error 5), the others returned 1801; none opened a handle, so no bypass was found. A name with a comma or control character is refused as invalid_printer before OpenPrinterW as hardening (22a3d16e2).

trigger: printer=ipp://localhost:631/printers/%FF on macOS/Linux: the percent-DECODED name reached a row as a raw 0xFF byte
summary: A row is a protobuf string: it serialises but the server cannot parse the CommandResponse, its read loop ends and the session drops (the parse failure verified, the server effect read). Both name validators require strict UTF-8 (RFC 3629), e0bcb0c58. Introduced by the round-4 decoded echo.

trigger: a queue legally named with a question mark: cupsd leaves it unencoded in the job's own job-printer-uri and the strict operator-operand parser refuses it
summary: A job that IS on the queue read as not_found/FULL (nothing cancelled). printer_name_from_cupsd_uri() reads the whole remainder of a cupsd-generated URI; the strict parser stays for operator input (e0bcb0c58). Native LOW disagreed with the derived HIGH.

trigger: a listed job whose job-printer-uri is present but empty
summary: It read as elsewhere, so the row was an authoritative not_found/FULL; it is now unconfirmed (error/PARTIAL) like an absent URI (e0bcb0c58). Native SHOULD, derived HIGH.

trigger: a prefix-match or one-sided-fold regression in the name comparison
summary: Pinned in both directions and for a one-sided fold (e0bcb0c58).

trigger: a plain-char control-byte comparison in either validator would refuse every non-ASCII printer name
summary: UTF-8 accept and reject cases, including names that must still pass, were added (e0bcb0c58).

trigger: macOS/Linux jobs given a printer whose encoded printer-uri exceeds 65,535 bytes, or that is invalid, emits job|unavailable|invalid_printer
summary: The README CONSTRAINED cell and Outputs now name the token and the <kind>|unavailable|<token> row (e0bcb0c58).

trigger: a fleet-wide scheduled clear_queue cancels a different, unrelated document on each machine because job_id is endpoint-relative
summary: The reviewer adjudicated D3 as a deliberate, already-reviewed design shared by all pre-existing Destructive rows and asked only for a tracked follow-up; the derivation here is the recorder's, not the reviewer's.

trigger: printer=ipp://localhost:631/printers/we?rd (the string jobs prints) for a queue named with '?' that holds the job
summary: The strict operator-operand parser refused a '?' segment, so the pasted URI was looked up as a literal name: a false definitive not_found/FULL with the job left queued (nothing cancelled wrongly); the bare name and the %3F form worked. cupsd bars '/' and '#' in a queue name, not '?': only those are refused now and a ladder test (the real capture with the queue name substituted) pins the operations, rc, status, completeness and row (079d15121); reverting the parser change reddens 3 assertions in 2 cases. security-guardian (R6-2) raised the same behaviour and graded it LOW (I8, E4); the derived band of the stronger derivation governs.

trigger: a regression in is_valid_utf8's C1 lead, the E0/ED/EF/F4 branches or the third and fourth continuation checks
summary: One mutant survived (allowing the C1 overlong lead) and an over-strict E0/ED/EF/F4 branch or a bad third/fourth continuation byte would not have been caught; vectors added (079d15121). Independently, cpp-safety ran a 27M-string differential and security-guardian a 1.1M-code-point oracle against reference decoders with no disagreement.

trigger: printer=ipp://localhost:631/printers/%FF (or Caf%E9) on macOS/Linux: the refusal cause is documented nowhere but code comments
summary: README, YAML and the generated manifest now list 'not valid UTF-8' among the invalid_printer causes on both OS legs (079d15121). Also docs-writer N2.

trigger: a reader of the unconfirmed-verdict comment, which said this Mac's cupsd returns job-printer-uri even under JobPrivateValues
summary: Only the upstream source supports the JobPrivateValues half; the comment now attributes it to upstream copy_job_attrs() and says this Mac's cupsd was shown to return the attribute when asked. docs-writer N4 raised the unanchored 'measured' wording for '?', also reworded (079d15121).

trigger: a reader of the comments giving ,XcvPort as the recognised special-handle form, and describing the elsewhere verdict as only a different printer
summary: The measured form is ,XcvMonitor Local Port; the elsewhere verdict also covers an unrecognised URI shape, failing closed either way (079d15121).

trigger: a local user submits a job whose name carries an overlong or surrogate UTF-8 sequence that cupsd may accept; the jobs action emits it in a row without UTF-8 sanitising, and the server cannot parse a non-UTF-8 CommandResponse
summary: Outside this diff: the merged read-only jobs/printers rows never used sanitize_utf8, unlike sibling plugins; clear_queue's own echo is validated. A scratch libcups test showed ippValidateAttribute accepts overlong and surrogate forms in a name attribute (it rejected a bare 0xFF); cupsd's own acceptance and the server's loop exit were not run. Added to #4681 (read-path parity). Derived HIGH if the trigger holds; raised for adjudication, not fixed here.
waiver_rationale: Pre-existing surface outside this remediation's diff (the merged read-only jobs/printers actions); not introduced or newly reachable by this change, and the trigger is unverified end to end. Tracked on #4681 so the reviewer can weigh it; recording this does not establish that a gating finding may be released.
